A '''star system''' was a part of the [[Homon sector/Legends|Homon sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was located on a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] that connected it to the [[Asamin system/Legends|Asamin system]] of the adjacent [[Strabin sector/Legends|Strabin sector]] as well as the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Adin system/Legends|Adin system]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] contained the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Triewahl Docking Station]].<ref name="AIR" />

At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Callandri]] and [[Zayl Braith]] attacked the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] operatives [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Alton Lochner]] and [[Tirranna]] on Triewahl Docking Station.<ref name="AIR" /> The [[Star/Legends|star]] system was part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The star system containing Triewahl Docking Station was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-7.<ref name="TEA" />
